I'll need to update the project file to make it an executable and swap in the v3 packages, check if any attribute properties have changed in the test files, and update the runner configuration.

The test project essentially becomes a self-contained executable, which means the `global.json` runner configuration might need to be removed or adjusted since v3 handles this differently.
